title: Micro Bolus Represented by SBM Marker
symptom: SMB markers are shown for small boluses (<=0.3U) by default, even for non-looping users, cluttering the xDrip timeline and preventing users from tracking their micro boluses. There is also a bug where entering 0.299U results in 99U being registered.
cause: The SMB marker feature was introduced as default for small boluses, affecting boluses <=0.3U, and there is a rounding bug when entering values like 0.299U.
fix: A new setting was added in the 27th Aug nightly under 'xDrip+ display settings' to disable the SMB marker graphic, allowing the value to be shown instead. The rounding bug was to be addressed separately in issue #565.
settings_changed: xDrip+ display settings → new setting to disable SMB marker
evidence_quote: Please try the 27th Aug nightly, see the new setting in `xDrip+ display settings`
